columns.meta_key: name of the constant, e.g. 'as_of_timestamp' (the dataset's 'today', 2025-12-20 00:00:00), 'seed', 'engine'

airports.description: airports in the network, one row per airport

columns.name: airport name
columns.longest_runway_m: length of the longest runway in metres
columns.is_cargo_hub: 1 if the airport is a cargo hub, else 0
columns.annual_cargo_capacity_t: yearly cargo handling capacity in tonnes
columns.has_24h_customs: 1 if customs is open 24 hours, else 0
columns.night_curfew: 1 if the airport has a night curfew, else 0

airlines.description: cargo airlines (carriers), one row per airline

columns.iata_code: 2-letter IATA airline code; flight numbers start with it
columns.name: airline name
columns.is_cargo_only: 1 if the airline flies only cargo (freighter-only), 0 if it also carries passengers

aircraft_types.description: freighter aircraft models, one row per model

columns.max_volume_m3: maximum cargo volume in cubic metres
columns.fuel_burn_kg_per_hour: typical fuel burn in kg per hour
columns.main_deck_positions: number of pallet positions on the main deck

aircraft.description: individual aircraft (airframes) of the fleet, one row per aircraft

columns.home_airport_id: home base airport of the aircraft
columns.delivery_date: date the aircraft was delivered to the airline
columns.lessor_name: leasing company; only for leased aircraft
columns.lease_end_date: date the lease ends; only for leased aircraft
columns.total_flight_hours: lifetime flight hours of the aircraft
columns.last_heavy_check_date: date of the last heavy maintenance check
columns.status: aircraft status: 'active', 'maintenance' or 'retired'; only active aircraft fly

customers.description: customers (shippers and freight forwarders) who book shipments

columns.name: customer (company) name
columns.sales_region: sales region the customer belongs to
columns.payment_terms_days: payment terms in days (invoice due this many days after issue)
columns.is_known_shipper: 1 if the customer is a security-screened known shipper, else 0
columns.created_date: date the customer account was created

columns.operator_name: ground-handling company that runs the warehouse
columns.min_temperature_c: coldest room temperature in degrees C; NULL when there are no cold rooms
columns.has_dg_area: 1 if it has a dangerous-goods area, else 0
columns.is_bonded: 1 if it is a customs-bonded warehouse, else 0
columns.operates_24h: 1 if open 24 hours a day, else 0

crew_members.description: crew members (pilots and loadmasters) employed by the airlines

columns.airline_id: airline that employs the crew member
columns.base_airport_id: home base airport of the crew member
columns.type_rating_id: aircraft model the pilot is qualified (type-rated) to fly; pilots only
columns.license_expiry_date: date the pilot licence expires; pilots only
columns.medical_expiry_date: date the medical certificate expires; pilots only
columns.hire_date: date the crew member was hired
columns.seniority_number: seniority rank inside the airline (1 = most senior)
columns.total_flight_hours: lifetime flight hours of the crew member
columns.is_active: 1 if currently active (employed and flying), else 0

flights.description: individual flights, one row per flight

columns.flight_number: flight number = airline IATA code + 3 digits
columns.actual_departure: actual departure time; completed flights only
columns.actual_arrival: actual arrival time; completed flights only
columns.takeoff_weight_kg: actual take-off weight in kg; completed flights only
columns.weather_at_departure: weather at departure, e.g. 'clear', 'rain', 'fog'; NULL for future flights
columns.delay_code: IATA delay code (text), only for completed flights that left more than 15 minutes late
columns.cancellation_reason: reason for cancellation, e.g. 'weather'; cancelled flights only

crew_assignments.description: crew duties: which crew member works on which flight, one row per crew member per flight

columns.is_pilot_flying: 1 if this pilot flies the aircraft on this flight (exactly one per flight), else 0
columns.report_time: time the crew member reports for duty
columns.release_time: time the crew member is released from duty
columns.block_minutes_credited: block minutes credited for the duty; completed duties only
columns.rest_minutes_before: rest minutes since the crew member's previous duty; NULL for the first duty
columns.per_diem_usd: daily allowance paid for the duty in USD
columns.hotel_required: 1 if a hotel night is needed, else 0

maintenance_records.description: maintenance work orders (checks and repairs) on aircraft

columns.airport_id: airport where the work was done
columns.ata_chapter: ATA chapter (aircraft system) worked on; unscheduled work only
columns.mro_provider: maintenance company (MRO provider) that did the work
columns.end_time: end time of the work; NULL while in progress
columns.parts_cost_usd: cost of parts in USD; completed work only
columns.labor_cost_usd: cost of labour in USD; completed work only
columns.deferred_items_count: number of defects deferred to later
columns.is_aog: 1 if the aircraft was grounded unexpectedly (AOG, aircraft on ground), else 0
columns.next_due_date: date the next check of this kind is due

fuel_uplifts.description: fuel loaded into an aircraft before a completed flight, one row per flight

columns.flight_id: flight the fuel was loaded for
columns.airport_id: airport where the fuel was loaded (the flight's origin)
columns.delivery_method: how the fuel was delivered: 'hydrant' or 'truck'
columns.density_kg_per_l: fuel density in kg per litre
columns.price_usd_per_litre: fuel price in USD per litre
columns.saf_blend_pct: share of sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) in percent, 0 if none
columns.fuel_burned_kg: fuel burned on the flight in kg
columns.co2_emissions_kg: CO2 emitted on the flight in kg

shipments.description: shipments (consignments) booked by customers, one row per shipment

columns.requested_delivery_date: delivery date the customer asked for
columns.chargeable_weight_kg: weight that is charged, in kg = max(actual weight, volume x 167)
columns.declared_value_usd: declared value of the goods in USD
columns.dg_class: dangerous goods class; NULL if not dangerous goods
columns.is_temperature_controlled: 1 if the shipment needs temperature control, else 0
columns.min_temperature_c: lowest allowed temperature in degrees C; temperature-controlled only
columns.max_temperature_c: highest allowed temperature in degrees C; temperature-controlled only

flight_cargo.description: shipment legs: which shipment is carried on which flight (a shipment has 1 or 2 legs)

columns.leg_number: leg number: 1 = first flight, 2 = connecting flight
columns.uld_number: ULD number; NULL for bulk cargo
columns.deck: deck where it is loaded: 'main' or 'lower'
columns.seal_number: security seal number on high-value ULDs
columns.loaded_at: time it was loaded; flown legs only

invoices.description: invoices for shipments, one per departed shipment

columns.shipment_id: shipment that is invoiced (the customer is the shipment's customer)
columns.dg_surcharge_usd: dangerous goods surcharge in USD, 0 if none
columns.amount_usd: total amount due in USD = charges + fees + surcharges - discount
columns.sent_via: how the invoice was sent: 'email', 'portal' or 'edi'

payments.description: payments received from customers against invoices

columns.original_currency: currency the customer paid in, e.g. 'EUR', 'USD'
columns.exchange_rate_to_usd: USD per 1 unit of the original currency

incidents.description: incidents (damage, delay, loss, temperature problems...) on a shipment leg

columns.airport_id: airport where it was reported (destination of the leg)
columns.delay_minutes: delay in minutes; delay incidents only
columns.claim_amount_usd: amount the customer may claim in USD

insurance_claims.description: insurance claims filed for incidents, one per incident

columns.approved_amount_usd: amount approved in USD; NULL if not approved
columns.rejection_reason: reason for rejection; rejected claims only

customs_declarations.description: customs declarations (export and import) for cross-border shipments

columns.warehouse_id: bonded warehouse where it is lodged
columns.customs_country: country whose customs handles the declaration
columns.customs_value_usd: customs value of the goods in USD
columns.inspection_required: 1 if a physical inspection was required, else 0
columns.inspection_result: result of the inspection: 'passed' or 'discrepancy'; NULL if no inspection

columns.flight_id: flight; DEP and ARR events only
columns.warehouse_id: warehouse; RCS, RCF, NFD and DLV events only
columns.event_code: event: BKD booked, RCS received from shipper, DEP departed, ARR arrived, RCF received from flight, NFD consignee notified, DLV delivered (handed over) to consignee, CAN cancelled
columns.weight_kg: scale weight in kg; RCS events only
columns.temperature_c: temperature reading in degrees C; temperature-controlled shipments only
columns.scanner_id: handheld scanner id; ground-handler events only
